when_to_use: 固定选项里选一个，不能自由输入
prompt_en: Build a single Select (dropdown single-select), not a full page. Structure: a trigger button showing the current value with a chevron, opening a vertical listbox of 4-6 text options. Interaction: click to open, click an option to select and close, click outside or Esc to close. States: default, open, option hover, option selected (checkmark or highlight), disabled. Motion: subtle 150ms fade/scale on the panel. Do not use a Combobox or a native <select>. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做成一个下拉单选框，不是整页。结构：触发按钮显示当前值并带下拉箭头，展开一个纵向选项列表（4-6 个文本项）。交互：点击展开，点选项即选中并收起，点外部或 Esc 关闭。状态：默认、展开、选项悬停、选项选中（打勾或高亮）、禁用。动效：面板 150ms 淡入微缩放。不要做成组合框，也不要用原生 select。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 已选项以可删 Chip 出现在框内
prompt_en: Build a single Multi-select dropdown, not a full page. Structure: a trigger box whose selected items render as removable chips inside the box, opening a listbox where clicking toggles membership without closing. Interaction: open, toggle options on/off, remove a chip via its × button, click outside or Esc to close. States: default, open, option hover, option selected, box focus. Motion: 150ms panel fade. Do not use a single-select dropdown or a Tag Input (no free typing). If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做成一个下拉多选框，不是整页。结构：触发框内已选项渲染为可删除的 chip，展开列表后点选切换且不收起。交互：展开、勾选/取消选项、点 chip 的 × 删除、点外部或 Esc 关闭。状态：默认、展开、选项悬停、选项已选、聚焦。动效：面板 150ms 淡入。不要做成单选下拉，也不要做成标签输入（不允许自由输入文字）。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 可输入、过滤、选已有项，不是 Select
prompt_en: Build a single Combobox (searchable select), not a full page. Structure: a text input you can type in, with a dropdown listbox of fixed options filtered as you type. Interaction: typing filters the list, arrow keys move highlight, Enter selects, Esc clears/closes, click outside closes. States: empty, typing with matches, no matches (show a short empty line), selected. Motion: none or 100ms fade. Do not use a plain Select (no typing) or an Autocomplete (must only allow existing options, not free text). If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做成一个组合框（可搜索选择），不是整页。结构：一个可输入文字的文本框，展开固定选项列表，输入即过滤。交互：输入过滤列表，方向键移动高亮，Enter 选中，Esc 清空或关闭，点外部关闭。状态：空、输入有匹配、无匹配（显示一行简短空提示）、已选中。动效：无或 100ms 淡入。不要做成纯下拉（不允许输入），也不要做成自动完成（只能选已有项，不允许自由文本）。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 输入时出建议，核心仍是文本框
prompt_en: Build a single Autocomplete input, not a full page. Structure: a free-text input whose core value is typed text; as you type, a suggestion list appears below with matching items. Interaction: typing updates suggestions, click or Enter accepts a suggestion into the input, Esc dismisses suggestions, arrow keys navigate. States: empty, typing, suggestions open, no suggestions, value committed. Motion: 100ms fade on the list. Do not use a Combobox or Select — the user must be able to keep arbitrary text. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做成一个自动完成输入框，不是整页。结构：核心是自由输入的文本框，输入时下方出现匹配建议列表。交互：输入更新建议，点击或 Enter 采纳建议填入输入框，Esc 关闭建议，方向键导航。状态：空、输入中、建议展开、无建议、已提交。动效：列表 100ms 淡入。不要做成组合框或下拉选择——必须允许用户保留任意输入的文字。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Cascader, not a full page. Structure: a trigger showing the selected path joined by separators; opening it reveals columns of levels (region → city → district) where picking from one column loads/opens the next to its side. Interaction: click a level item to advance, hover or click shows the next column, selecting a leaf sets the full path and closes; simulate async loading of children with a brief spinner. States: default, open, level item hover, level loading, leaf selected. Motion: column slide-in 150ms. Do not use a flat Select or a Tree dropdown in a single panel. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做成一个级联选择器，不是整页。结构：触发器显示所选路径（分隔符连接），展开后出现多列层级（省 → 市 → 区），在某一列点选后旁边加载/展开下一列。交互：点某级条目进入下一级，选中叶子节点后写入完整路径并关闭；子级加载用短暂 spinner 模拟异步。状态：默认、展开、条目悬停、加载中、叶子已选。动效：列 150ms 滑入。不要用扁平下拉，也不要用单面板树形下拉。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

prompt_en: Build a single Tree Select, not a full page. Structure: a trigger box opening one dropdown panel containing an expandable tree (carets, indentation, one level of nesting at least three nodes). Interaction: click caret to expand/collapse a branch, click a node to select it (single select) and show it in the trigger, Esc/outside closes. States: node default/hover/selected, branch expanded/collapsed, trigger filled. Motion: branch expand 150ms. Do not use a Cascader with columns — it must be a single vertical tree panel. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做成一个树选择器，不是整页。结构：触发框展开一个下拉面板，内含可展开的树（折叠箭头、缩进、至少三层节点）。交互：点箭头展开/收起分支，点节点选中（单选）并回填触发框，Esc 或点外部关闭。状态：节点默认/悬停/已选、分支展开/收起、触发框已填值。动效：分支展开 150ms。不要做成多列级联——必须是单个纵向树面板。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
